description: versus-2p-bamboo with g_fight_mode_selector (0x800A38DC, s16) poked 4 -> 6 at frame 7535, the t_init phase (a modified game): mode 6 is the link-cable mode (ApplyPendingConfigAndInitializeMode's case 6, 24BF0.c:46-52), which needs a second console; ApplyPendingConfigResetCellsAndClearSlotTimGroupRequests writes 4 at 7534 and fight_Init runs at 7535 (a write watch and a fight_Init breakpoint in an exploratory run), so the poke lands between the two; fight_Init's last statement (9F9C.c:2067-2069) calls rng_SetSeed(g_fight_rng_seed) in mode 6, and snd_StartFightCdAudio (9F9C.c:1800-1832) starts no stage CD audio; the WINS counters are drawn only in mode 4 (9F9C.c:1547-1552), so the fight draws none and still ends in a KO and the Rematch menu
